chapter: Europe and South America with Sam Wooding
title: South America and Cairo
summary: He calls South America sensational and says they played Shepherd's Hotel in Cairo for two weeks in 1927, but visited North Africa only in 1964.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Oh, sensational, South America was sensational.
Did you go to Africa, any parts of it?
Yes, we played the Shepherd's Hotel in Cairo, Egypt, in '27. We had a two-week engagement, two weeks.
Well, what parts of northern Africa were you touching? Any parts of Tunisia, Algiers, Casablanca?
Well, not in those days, but I'd say recently, because in 1964 I was at those places.
Back then, no. We just went directly to Cairo.
